world: a volcanic cave with rivers of glowing lava, cracked black basalt, falling embers and red-orange heat haze

b-salamander.describe: a fiery salamander lizard with glowing orange cracked scales and a flame-tipped curled tail

b-golem.describe: a towering lava golem made of jagged black volcanic rocks with glowing molten lava cracks running through its body, massive fists, hunched powerful stance

b-dragon.describe: a mighty crimson fire dragon with spread wings, horned head, ember-glowing scales and a long tail
